notes.title: v1.0.3 - Small changes
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where encountering one of the endings would sometimes lock a player out of getting another ending in the next run.
 Added text to chapter one to clarify keyboard is an option as well as mouse.
 Mini games reward a liiiiiittle bit more Babette happiness in chapter five.

notes.title: v1.0.2 - Small fixes
notes.content:
Made the left-most paw button better clickable. The wrong hitbox was being used, resulting in parts of the button not registering clicks.
Fixed Steam overlay's F12 screenshot option. Screenshots are saved in the local Babette folder too.
Babette gets a liiiiiittle less angry in chapter five.

notes.title: v1.0.1 - Small fixes
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where on some PCs the kibble from the feeding mini game sporadically disappeared.
 Multiple achievements, if not granted yet but the player is eligible, are granted when entering the titlescreen.
 After one of the endings, progress is now correctly set back to level 1 for replayability.
